cookbooks.title: Getting Started with AnythingLLM + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Configure AnythingLLM to use Valkey as its vector database, understand the per-namespace storage model, and run a minimal GLIDE mirror that creates an index, stores a chunk, and runs a KNN search.

cookbooks.title: Vector Search & Retrieval with AnythingLLM + Valkey
cookbooks.h1: Vector Search & Retrieval with AnythingLLM + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Reproduce AnythingLLM's retrieval path: KNN search with bound PARAMS, COSINE distance to similarity scoring, similarity-threshold and topN filtering, and pinned-source exclusion.

cookbooks.title: Production Operations with AnythingLLM + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Run AnythingLLM's Valkey provider in production: TLS and auth, request timeouts, the dimension-change guard, namespace deletion, bounded SCAN cleanup, full reset, and cluster considerations.
